$comment: The three `unknownPolicy` values on a record, and the absence of any validation effect on the kinds that carry no declared member set. Expectations are read off `### Unknown members` in `spec/functional/FR-066-generate-runtime-validators.md` and off `ir/unknown.ir.json`. None was recorded from a run.

cases.title: reject: a declared member alone is accepted
reject: an undeclared member is rejected at its own pointer
surface: an undeclared member leaves ok true and is surfaced
surface: a conforming value with no undeclared member surfaces nothing
preserve: an undeclared member is carried through unchanged
preserve: a declared field keeps its declared type and is not carried
preserve: a declared field of the wrong type is still rejected
preserve: a preserved __proto__ member mutates no prototype
cases.differentialReason: `__proto__` in a JSON document is an ordinary member and ajv treats it as one, so the second decider agrees trivially and says nothing about the prototype-mutation hazard this case exists to check. The hazard is a JavaScript object-construction property, not a JSON Schema one.

cases.title: a map declaring preserve gains no validation effect
a map still rejects a value of the wrong declared type
a sequence declaring surface gains no validation effect
a sequence still rejects a member of the wrong declared type
